estilo-redaccion.title: Writing style
estilo-redaccion.hint: Tone, structure, words you use and avoid. Used by CVs and letters.

perfil-conductual.title: Behavioral profile
perfil-conductual.hint: How you work, strengths, personality tests. For preparing interviews.

criterios.title: Criteria
criterios.hint: Deal-breakers and preferences in free text. The fit assessment cites them as risks.

narrativa.title: Narrative
narrativa.hint: Your story, motivation and how you explain changes. For interviews.

folders.candidaturas: What you sent in each application (fills up on its own)
folders.estilo: Samples of how you write (letters, emails, posts): the agent takes your tone from them, never facts.

contextIntro: It guides your agent: the tone of your CVs and letters, the risks of a job and interview prep. It never backs a fact: whatever a CV or letter says must be in your profile. Edit these files above, in your editor or with your agent (update-profile).
documentsIntro: Your source documents. update-profile can read them to create or extend your profile, always asking you before writing.
expandHint: Your agent reads your public links (GitHub, portfolio, Kaggle, Scholar) and proposes projects, skills, achievements and certifications, each with its source. It only writes to your profile what you accept. Best right after creating it.
title: My profile
intro: Your profile (data/profile.yaml) is the only thing a CV, letter or answer can claim. Fill it in here block by block: each one saves on its own, keeps your file's formatting and can be undone. You can still edit the YAML or ask your agent if you prefer.
